label: Именно
description: A 10-sentence usage card for именно (exactly, precisely).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Pinpointing a focus. 'Именно' means exactly or precisely, singling out 'это' as the very thing meant. It stands before the word it identifies as the precise target.
Strategic focus: Sharpening an adverb. 'Именно' tightens 'вовремя' to mean precisely on time. It precedes the adverb to stress exactness rather than degree.
Strategic focus: Selecting one item. 'Именно' marks 'этот ключ' as the exact one required and no other. The particle precedes the noun phrase it pins down.
Strategic focus: Emphasising a reason. 'Именно' strengthens 'поэтому', meaning that is exactly why. It fronts the causal link to highlight the precise cause.
Strategic focus: Pinpointing a place. 'Именно' singles out 'здесь' as the exact spot of the event. It precedes the place adverb to fix the location precisely.
Strategic focus: Singling out a person. 'Именно' before 'ты' stresses that it is exactly you and no one else. Fronting the particle gives the strongest emphasis on the subject.
Strategic focus: Confirming with precision. In 'именно так', the particle confirms that it happened exactly that way. It works as an emphatic agreement marker in dialogue.
Strategic focus: Exact location with a preposition. 'Именно' highlights 'в парке' as the precise place of meeting. The particle sits before the prepositional phrase it pinpoints.
Strategic focus: Pinpointing a moment. 'Именно' sharpens 'сейчас' to mean right now exactly. It precedes the time adverb to mark this very moment as the one.

missions.phrase: Он сказал именно то, что думал.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Exact correspondence. 'Именно' before 'то' stresses that he said precisely what he thought, with no gap. The particle points to the exact content of the clause.
